canada.title: More than 2,000 without power in centre city St. John's
canada.summary: Newfoundland Power says more than 2,000 homes and businesses are without power on Friday evening in St. John's.

canada.title: Saskatoon police seek person seen ‘prowling’ before suspicious house fire
canada.summary: Police are asking the public for help identifying a person of interest in connection with an alleged arson that occurred at a home in Saskatoon.

canada.title: Winnipeg police suspending use of Crime Stoppers after data breach uncovered
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Police Service says it is suspending its use of Crime Stoppers after an exclusive CBC News investigation uncovered a massive data breach that leaked more than 1.5 million tips reported in Canada.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News, Winnipeg Free Press

canada.title: Video of burn barrel fire shows 'zero remorse' for victim's life, Crown tells murder trial jurors
canada.summary: Video of a large burn barrel fire seized from an accused killer’s cellphone shows the “incineration” of Christopher Stevenson’s body and depicts a “celebration,” the prosecution told jurors Friday during closing arguments in a Calgary courtroom.

canada.title: 'We must take action': Georgina's Law debated in House of Commons 2nd reading
canada.summary: Georgina's Law — a bill spearheaded by an N.L. survivor of intimate partner violence — was a focus in Ottawa this week, during its second reading in the House of Commons.

canada.title: Regis Korchinski-Paquet’s mother shown security footage at inquest
canada.summary: Regis Korchinski-Paquet’s mother was shown snippets of security footage from the day her daughter died as she resumed her testimony at a coroner’s inquest after making a new allegation against police involved in the case.

canada.title: Manitoba government drops plan to limit new autism strategy to children
canada.summary: The Manitoba government is withdrawing amendments to a Liberal MLA's bill that would have made a new provincial autism strategy only apply to children.

canada.title: Demolition work halted at Canada Malting plant in Montreal after partial collapse
canada.summary: Demolition work that began Monday at the Canada Malting plant in Montreal's Sud-Ouest borough has been put on hold following a partial collapse. The developer said it was informed of the incident on Wednesday and no one was injured.

canada.title: Bookshop on wheels hits the streets of Moncton
canada.summary: A new bookshop has opened up in Moncton, but you’ll have to go to a different place to find it each time.

canada.title: We’re hearing more about rabies in the news. Here’s what to know about the virus
canada.summary: Public health officials in B.C. and Quebec are dealing with rabies in wild animals that have come into contact with people or domestic pets.

canada.title: Conservatives hold advantage with B.C. election day one day away: poll
canada.summary: The poll shows the BC Conservatives at 44 per cent, up one from the last poll, while the BC NDP are still five points behind at 39 per cent, and the BC Green Party at 13 per cent.

canada.title: Yukon government asks court to toss Tr’ondëk Hwëch’in lawsuit over mining regulation changes
canada.summary: The territory has filed a statement of defence to the First Nation's lawsuit, arguing it wasn't obligated to consult before making changes to three mining-related regulations in 2025.

canada.title: Lack of security at psychiatric ER puts workers at risk in Quebec City hospital, unions say
canada.summary: Psychiatric emergency department workers say hospital security measures are lacking. They stood outside the Centre hospitalier de l'Université Laval (CHUL) in Quebec City Friday to demand safety improvements.

canada.title: N.W.T. MLAs decry lengthy medical travel flights for seniors
canada.summary: MLAs in the Legislative Assembly are decrying lengthy flights for medical travel for seniors. Some are calling for change. The territory’s new health minister says he’s willing to look at anything — but did not promise any immediate, new exemptions.

canada.title: Developer pitching subdivision outside Shubenacadie gets earful
canada.summary: An open house about a proposed subdivision that could bring dozens of homes near the Shubenacadie Wildlife Park started with the proponent informing area residents that construction could theoretically start at any time.

canada.title: U.S. price-fixing case advances against Canadian frozen potato giants
canada.summary: New Brunswick’s McCain Foods Limited and J.D. Irving-owned Cavendish Farms were among five defendants seeking the case’s dismissal.

canada.title: Advocates point to contributions, not costs, of newcomers in Alberta referendum aftermath
canada.summary: A union representative for a beef processing plant south of Calgary is warning of worsening labour shortages if immigration policy proposals that narrowly passed in Alberta's referendum are enacted.

canada.title: Ballots cast on election day in B.C. will be counted by hand, Elections BC says
canada.summary: It's the last full day of campaigning in British Columbia's election ahead of final voting day Saturday, when most ballots will be counted by hand.
canada.outlet: Global News, CBC News, Ottawa Citizen
